user.title: Devialet Expert
user.description: Expert non-Pro UDP protocol (experimental). Starts read-only. HA must receive broadcasts on UDP 45454 from this IPv4 address.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Only one amplifier is supported because the listener owns UDP 45454.

init.title: Amplifier safety
init.description: Leave read-only enabled until command encoding is physically verified. Controls are experimental. Volume spans the full -96.5 to +30 dB range, with no reduced-volume safety ceiling. High volume can damage speakers or hearing. Commands are confirmed only by subsequent broadcasts.
